capabilities: Replaces personal data with stable placeholders
Keeps an encrypted mapping in per-device vault files
Shows plain text in reading view and Live Preview
extras: Explicitly states it is pseudonymization, not anonymization, and not legal advice; documents many limits and sync caveats; makes no network requests.
problem: Agents, sync services, Git remotes and backups read vault files as plain text, exposing names, addresses and phone numbers.
summary: Privacy utility that replaces personal data in notes with stable placeholders, keeps an encrypted mapping, and shows plain text while reading.
